1: -module(hty_fspath_SUITE).
    2: -compile(export_all).
    3: 
    4: all() -> [
    5:     {group, move},
    6:     {group, copy}
    7: ].
    8: 
    9: groups() -> [
   10:   {move, [
   11:     move_direct_child_file,
   12:     move_direct_child_folder,
   13:     move_nested_source
   14:   ]},
   15:   {copy, [
   16:     copy_direct_child_file,
   17:     copy_direct_child_folder,
   18:     copy_nested_source,
   19:     copy_missing_dst_folder,
   20:     copy_preexisting_dst_file
   21:   ]}
   22: ].
   23: 
   24: 
   25: -record(test_move_or_copy, {mode, xpct, from, dest}).
   26: 
   27: move_direct_child_file(Cfg) ->
   28:   test_move_or_copy(Cfg, #test_move_or_copy{
   29:       mode = move,
   30:       xpct = ok,
   31:       from = "move_direct_child_file_src",
   32:       dest = "move_direct_child_file_dst"
   33:   }).
   34: 
   35: move_direct_child_folder(Cfg) -> 
   36:     test_move_or_copy(Cfg, #test_move_or_copy{
   37:       mode = move,
   38:       xpct = ok,
   39:       from = "move_direct_child_folder_src",
   40:       dest = "move_direct_child_folder_dst"
   41:   }).
   42:     
   43: move_nested_source(Cfg) -> 
   44:     test_move_or_copy(Cfg, #test_move_or_copy{
   45:       mode = move,
   46:       xpct = ok,
   47:       from = "move_nested_source_src/file2move",
   48:       dest = "move_nested_source_dst/file2move"
   49:   }).
   50: 
   51: copy_direct_child_file(Cfg) ->
   52:   test_move_or_copy(Cfg, #test_move_or_copy{
   53:       mode = copy,
   54:       xpct = {ok, 3},
   55:       from = "copy_direct_child_file_src",
   56:       dest = "copy_direct_child_file_dst"
   57:   }).
   58:   
   59: copy_direct_child_folder(Cfg) -> 
   60:     test_move_or_copy(Cfg, #test_move_or_copy{
   61:       mode = copy,
   62:       xpct = ok,
   63:       from = "copy_direct_child_folder_src",
   64:       dest = "copy_direct_child_folder_dst"
   65:   }).
   66:     
   67: copy_nested_source(Cfg) -> 
   68:     test_move_or_copy(Cfg, #test_move_or_copy{
   69:       mode = copy,
   70:       xpct = {ok, 6},
   71:       from = "copy_nested_source_src/file2copy",
   72:       dest = "copy_nested_source_dst/file2copy"
   73:   }).
   74:     
   75: copy_missing_dst_folder(Cfg) ->
   76:     test_move_or_copy(Cfg, #test_move_or_copy{
   77:       mode = copy,
   78:       xpct = ok,
   79:       from = "copy_direct_child_folder_src",
   80:       dest = "copy_missing_dst_folder/newfile"
   81:   }).
   82:   
   83: copy_preexisting_dst_file(Cfg) ->
   84:     test_move_or_copy(Cfg, #test_move_or_copy{
   85:       mode = copy,
   86:       xpct = {error, eexist},
   87:       from = "copy_existing_file",
   88:       dest = "copy_existing_file_dst"
   89:   }).
   90: 
   91: test_move_or_copy(Cfg, #test_move_or_copy{from=From, dest=To, mode=MoveOrCopy, xpct=Expect}) ->
   92:   Filesdir = proplists:get_value(files_dir, Cfg),
   93:   From1 = Filesdir ++ From,
   94:   To1 = Filesdir ++ To,
   95:   io:format("Fromfile is [~p] and Tofile is [~p]~n", [From1, To1]),
   96:   %true = filelib:is_file(From1),
   97:   %false = filelib:is_file(To1),
   98:   Frompath = hty_fspath:new(From1),
   99:   Topath = hty_fspath:new(To1),
  100:   case MoveOrCopy of
  101:   % TODO recursive compare
  102:     move ->
  103:         Expect = hty_fspath:move(Frompath, Topath),
  104:         true = filelib:is_file(To1),
  105:         false = filelib:is_file(From1);
  106:     copy ->
  107:         Expect = hty_fspath:copy(Frompath, Topath),
  108:         true = filelib:is_file(To1),
  109:         true = filelib:is_file(From1)
  110:   end.
  111: 
  112: init_per_group(Grp, Config) ->
  113:     Datadir = proplists:get_value(data_dir, Config),
  114:     Fromdir = Datadir ++ atom_to_list(Grp) ++ "/files/",
  115:     Todir = proplists:get_value(priv_dir, Config) ++ "/hty_fspath/" ++ atom_to_list(Grp) ++ "/files/",
  116:     copy_fixture(Fromdir, Todir),
  117:     [{files_dir, Todir}|Config].
  118: 
  119: end_per_group(_Group, Config) ->
  120:     Config.
  121: 
  122: %%% Support
  123: copy_fixture(From, To) ->
  124:     case filelib:is_dir(From) of
  125:         true ->
  126:             filelib:ensure_dir(To),
  127:             file:make_dir(To),
  128:             {ok, Filenames} = file:list_dir(From),
  129:             lists:foreach(fun(Filename) ->
  130:                 copy_fixture(From ++ "/" ++ Filename, To ++ "/" ++ Filename)
  131:             end, Filenames);
  132:         false ->
  133:             ok = filelib:ensure_dir(To),
  134:             io:format("Copying from ~s to ~s", [From, To]),
  135:             {ok, _} = file:copy(From, To)
  136:     end.
